title: Pluggable Discounts (Strategy)
summary: Replace an if/else pricing ladder with interchangeable discount strategies and pick the best one at checkout.
hints: Each discount type is one class/struct behind a single interface with one method: given the cart, how much money comes off?
Checkout should not know which concrete strategies exist. It receives a list and asks each one.
Buy-N-get-one-free: for every (n+1) units of the SKU, one unit is free. Integer division is your friend.
Clamp: a discount can never make the total negative.
